name: Employee Dashboard — personal stats, quick actions, recent sales

planSteps.description: Enter phone number 923001122334 and click Send Code

The employee dashboard loads showing greeting with employee name, today's sales summary card with total sales, paid count, and credit amount, quick actions (New Sale, Record Payment), and recent sales list
The Select Customer page loads for the employee to start a new sale
Go back and click the Sales tab in the bottom navigation
The employee sales list shows only their own sales with customer name, date, Credit/Paid tag, and amount
